_comment: Generic template for the learn-mode surfacing ledger. Copy to config/learn-progress.json (your private instance data — never committed to the public engine). 'thresholds' drive the taper: a term is defined in full until 'full_max' surfacings, briefly until 'summarized_max', then only occasionally. 'terms' is filled automatically by scripts/parse-learn-transcript.ps1 (or by the agent at session close).
